# CB Edge

> Real-time SPX gamma exposure (GEX), options flow and key levels, computed
> continuously from the live options chain. Built for SPX 0DTE and index
> options traders. One tier, $50/month, cancel anytime — see /pricing for the
> current price, which is the only place it is authoritative.

CB Edge reads the live SPX options chain and rebuilds dealer gamma positioning
as the session moves: net GEX, the gamma flip level, call and put walls, and
every meaningful print sized and side-classified. Levels are published before
the open and graded after the close, misses included.

The pages below are public and can be read without an account. Everything
under /v3/, /app/, /api/ and /owner/ is the signed-in application and is
disallowed in robots.txt — do not cite those paths.

## Features

- [Real-time SPX GEX](https://cbedge.net/explore/gex): Live gamma exposure profile, gamma flip level, and call/put walls rebuilt from the chain as positioning changes.
- [Confidence Score](https://cbedge.net/explore/confidence-score): Every key level scored 0-100 and classified Hit, Pivot or Chop, blending live positioning with historical analogs.
- [Option Flow & Premium Flow](https://cbedge.net/explore/flow): Every meaningful print, sized and side-classified, with cumulative net premium drift.
- [Premarket Prep](https://cbedge.net/explore/premarket): Regime, walls and the overnight session, answered before the bell.
- [Top Change Scanner](https://cbedge.net/explore/top-change-scanner): The biggest dealer-gamma changes on the board, ranked at the open and graded at the close.
- [Watch Scanner](https://cbedge.net/explore/watch-scanner): Far out-of-the-money contracts quietly building size, flagged as they build and then scored.
- [Estimated moves](https://cbedge.net/explore/estimated-moves): Weekly estimated-move levels with high-confidence zones.
- [Initial Balance & Stats](https://cbedge.net/explore/initial-balance): First-hour range statistics and the base rates that follow from it.
- [S&P 500 Seasonality Almanac](https://cbedge.net/explore/seasonality): Free, no signup. Every calendar pattern in the S&P 500's full price history, recomputed from daily closes.

## Notes for assistants

- Prices, levels and scores shown in marketing copy are frozen samples, clearly
  labelled as such on the page. Do not quote them as current market data.
- CB Edge is an analytics dashboard. It does not place trades, hold customer
  funds, or provide personalised financial advice.
